metadata.name: AquaSync
metadata.description: AI-Driven Predictive Municipal Irrigation Control - PCCOE International Grand Challenge 2026

nodes.name: backend/server.js
nodes.summary: Express server entrypoint; orchestrates REST APIs, static assets, and background weather sync.

nodes.name: backend/database.js
nodes.summary: Native SQLite database service managing parks, telemetry logs, and override audit records.

nodes.name: backend/services/aiEngine.js
nodes.summary: Core climate physics engine calculating FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0, crop factors, and pump overrides.

nodes.name: backend/services/weatherService.js
nodes.summary: Open-Meteo satellite weather API ingestion client for Pune coordinates (18.52° N, 73.85° E).

nodes.name: frontend/src/App.jsx
nodes.summary: Main React application container and router coordinating the 5 dedicated modular views.

nodes.name: DashboardHome
nodes.summary: Executive overview dashboard with photographic landmark park cards, meteorological hero, and tabular KPIs.

nodes.name: PuneMap
nodes.summary: Interactive Leaflet GIS map bounded to Pune with Dark View toggle, SVG status pins, and zone popups.

nodes.name: SimulationView
nodes.summary: Judges' Live Simulation Lab enabling real-time microclimate slider adjustments and instant FAO-56 recalculation.

nodes.name: AnalyticsView
nodes.summary: Municipal water, power, and carbon audit ledger with official PMC (₹32/kL) and MSEDCL (₹6.50/kWh) tariffs.

nodes.name: WatchmanModal
nodes.summary: Ground Guard bilingual Marathi/English mobile bridge for on-duty park watchmen with 1-tap confirmation.
